question: Owner 2026-10-25: key levels (Monday high/low, range 0.5, 0.618, opposite 1.618): how often is each reached, and which laddered take-profit by score works best?
single_variable: Take-profit ladder across the five key levels, per score band; 60m confirmation, no backstop, everything else as the v2 rule.
selection: per band the ladder with the best 2025 mean net per trade, frozen for 2026 and the last five months
path_rule: worse of the two intrabar paths per trade

sizing.linear: 0.05 * (score - threshold) / mean excess score of 2025 top-40 fills, cap 0.5
